redFirst.basis: `node --test` in a throwaway tree at HEAD exited 1, but its output carries no test tally this command reads, so an assertion failure cannot be told from a crash - no test is known to have been collected: Error: Cannot find module '<outside-repo>'; run without CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR, OLDPWD; no ignored dependency directory linked from the project root; the user's .npmrc in the home directory dropped (every run has a fresh home); deadline: 480s, the default - the command is not a sweep naming suites, so there is no recorded cost to size it from

outcome.technical: Added scripts/pipeline.mjs (the build driver, 4 steps). plan <repo> --work --out --scope --profile --issues --update --since --project --generated-at: refuses a work dir inside the repo that git does not ignore and a non-empty dir plan did not make; clears its own files, runs prescan.mjs, takes the prescan areas (<=8), writes <work>/briefs/<area>.md (cap BRIEF_CAP=4000 chars; carries area, globs, extract and fragment paths, 20 tool calls, 40/80/60/80 caps, the fragment contract with vocabularies, the evidence rule and the three-line reply; drops the optional stack-reference line if a long path would overflow), prints one foreground Agent call per area (prompt = pointer to the brief, model only for max/economy). --update runs diffmap.mjs against <out>/architecture.model.json, briefs only affected areas plus areas of uncovered files, names the previous model; nothing affected -> no agents, next = render. finish --work [--usage <area>=<tokens>[@<duration>]] [--allow-missing]: missing fragment -> exit 2 naming the path and `missing`; introspects prescan-listed sqlite/duckdb files when the CLI is on PATH (schema only, read-only, duckdb on a temp copy; store node from a pre-merge of the fragments; new tables become observed entities, declared ones counted), else records a skipped source row; merge.mjs --extracts --repo --digest (--previous when a model exists in out, --areas on update) into <work>/model.json, validate.mjs --repo, writes <work>/briefs/synthesizer.md and prints the synthesizer call. render --work [--usage synthesizer=..]: merge --synth --previous <work>/model.json into <out>, validate --repo, layout.mjs seeded, render.mjs (+theme if present), prints files, counts, conflicts, notMapped, skipped, ledger total and a report skeleton with the usage table; with --issues prints the reviewer call. ledger --work --usage reviewer=..: records the reviewer row. Each step owns <work>/ledger/<step>.jsonl and rebuilds <work>/usage.jsonl, so reruns record rows once; script rows are tokens 0 with no wall-clock duration so outputs are byte-identical; run records print <work>/<out>/<repo> aliases; every step prints ONE JSON line with each script's exit and capped messages; exit 0/1/2. usage.mjs: exported makeRow and readLedger, added phases diffmap and validate. SKILL.md rewritten (318 lines, frontmatter lines 1-4 md5-identical): build flow = 1 Plan, 2 Dispatch the explorers, 3 Finish, 4 Dispatch the synthesizer, 5 Render, 6 Report; ONE foreground message per dispatch, forbids run_in_background, ScheduleWakeup, Monitor and polling; cap table; both three-line reply contracts; names no file to read and no script but pipeline.mjs; update flow uses plan --update; issues section keeps issues.mjs commands and records the reviewer row through pipeline.mjs ledger; usage.mjs add is no longer in SKILL.md. commands/build.md and update.md: frontmatter unchanged, name the driver and rule out polling. Edited outside the declared files, and the plan gate allowed each Edit: agents/archmap-explorer.md (the line 94 zones fix: merge.mjs fills meta and zones; Input and References now say the brief carries the contract and references are read only for what it leaves open), agents/archmap-synthesizer.md (the same Input and References change), docs/design.md (D11, the agent and script listing at lines 81-87, the build and update flows at lines 123-139). Tests: tests/pipeline.test.mjs p1-p12 (new); tests/e2e.test.mjs e5; tests/skill.test.mjs s10 and s11 (new), s3 and s7 rewritten for the driver; tests/commands.test.mjs c10. Fixture: tests/fixtures/e2e/pipeline/fragments/{prisma,root,src}.json, canned fragments named after the prescan areas, synthetic. Before the fix the new cases failed: `node --test` on the four files gave 14 failures (pipeline.mjs missing, SKILL not updated). After: `node --test` exit 0, 341/341; `node --test tests/denylist.test.mjs` 2/2 pass; the archmap-review scan over the worktree raised one med lead (new Date() in plan's default generatedAt), now documented in the header and fixed by --generated-at for reruns. New files staged; nothing committed. Measured on the e2e fixture with canned fragments (scratch paths about 110 characters): plan prints 2,616 characters, finish 1,633, render 3,955; with SKILL.md (21,759) and commands/build.md (798) the orchestrator holds 30,761 characters, about 7.7 K tokens at 4 characters per token (p11 asserts under 48 K characters, each step under 8 K). Briefs: about 3.5 K characters each, synthesizer 2.3 K. The flow implies 7 orchestrator turns without --issues: the skill load, plan, the explorer dispatch with the partition list, finish, the synthesizer dispatch, render, the report. That is within 12. NOT measured: no live headless session was run, so cost-profile.mjs has no transcript to profile. The 80 K maximum-context target is unverified; the measured driver surface (about 8 K tokens) excludes Claude Code's own system prompt and tool definitions. The duckdb introspection branch never ran: no duckdb CLI on this host. The sqlite ok branch and the no-CLI skip branch did run (p8). Dependants: scripts/usage.mjs -> tests/usage.test.mjs passes 11/11 (additive exports and phases); SKILL.md names usage.mjs only in its 'What the driver runs' table; tests/e2e.test.mjs e4 phase order is unchanged; docs/design.md D11 updated. SKILL.md -> tests/commands.test.mjs c5 passes (pipeline.mjs exists); tests/evals.test.mjs e16 passes (description unchanged); tests/skill.test.mjs updated; scripts/issues.mjs and tests/issues.test.mjs i6 rely on 'Output locations', kept verbatim; .agents/skills/node/tile.json and skills-lock.json are basename matches and unaffected; docs/design.md updated. commands/build.md and update.md -> docs/design.md section 4 listing still correct. tests/fixtures/e2e -> tests/e2e.test.mjs e1-e4 untouched and passing; scripts/lib/prescan/generic.mjs is a basename match, not affected. Explored outside the brief (to pick a test command the red helper can tally): stamp-verification.py _TALLY_KEYS lists house, pytest, unittest, jest and vitest, and no node:test TAP reader.
outcome.descriptive: A build is now three driver steps and two dispatch messages: pipeline.mjs does prescan, the briefs, introspection, merge, validate, layout, render and the ledger, and SKILL.md forbids polling, background dispatch and reading files during a build.

testsAdded: tests/pipeline.test.mjs p1: plan on the e2e fixture writes prescan, extracts and one brief per area under the 4000-character cap, each carrying the extract and fragment paths, the caps and the reply lines, and prints one pointer-prompt Agent call per area
tests/pipeline.test.mjs p2: profile max/economy put opus/haiku on every call; a bad profile exits 2 with step plan

tests/pipeline.test.mjs p3: finish with canned fragments and --usage pairs writes a model that passes validate --repo, a digest under 30 K, the synthesizer brief and call, and the explorer ledger rows (34.5k@62s parsed); stdout carries no fragment or model content

tests/pipeline.test.mjs p4: render with a canned synth writes model, layout and a self-contained HTML, merges the sequences, records the synthesizer, layout and render rows, and its report carries the printed ledger table

tests/pipeline.test.mjs p5: a second plan, finish and render with the same inputs is byte-identical in stdout, every work file and every out file; plan clears the last build's fragments, synth and later ledger rows

tests/pipeline.test.mjs p6: a missing work dir exits 2 naming finish or render; a missing fragment exits 2 naming its path and area; --allow-missing merges and names it not mapped; render without synth.json exits 2 naming it
tests/pipeline.test.mjs p7: usage errors exit 2 (no repo, an unknown step, a --usage label that is no area, a malformed token count)

tests/pipeline.test.mjs p8: a listed sqlite file with no CLI on PATH is recorded as skipped in finish and in meta.sources; with sqlite3 present, a new table becomes an observed entity on the owning store node and a declared table is not duplicated
tests/pipeline.test.mjs p9: plan --update briefs only the affected area, names the previous model, and finish and render merge with --areas; nothing affected lists no agent and render re-renders
tests/pipeline.test.mjs p10: with --issues render prints the reviewer call; ledger --usage reviewer records the row once across reruns
tests/pipeline.test.mjs p11: SKILL.md, build.md and the three steps' output with the replies stay under 48 K characters, each step under 8 K
tests/pipeline.test.mjs p12: plan refuses a non-empty dir it did not make and a work dir inside the repo that git does not ignore; a half-finished plan is refused by finish
tests/e2e.test.mjs e5: the plan, finish, render chain on the fixture passes validate --repo and the HTML is self-contained

tests/skill.test.mjs s10: the build flow is exactly plan, explorer dispatch, finish, synthesizer dispatch, render, report; names only pipeline.mjs; forbids ScheduleWakeup, Monitor and background dispatch; carries the cap table and both three-line replies; names no file to read; 7 turns <= 12; SKILL.md <= 500 lines
tests/skill.test.mjs s11: the s10 guard catches a flow that greps a reference or polls
tests/commands.test.mjs c10: build.md and update.md keep their exact frontmatter, point at the skill, name the driver, rule out polling and do not restate the flow
